test_title: SSC MTS Official Paper (Held On: 19 May, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error. If there is no error, select 'No error'.**

He consolidated control over all the/provinces of the Great Britain and some / of northern Gaul while Maximian dealt with other uprisings.

options.text: of northern Gaul while Maximian dealt with other uprisings.
He consolidated control over all the
provinces of the Great Britain and some

solution:
The correct answer is: "**provinces of the Great Britain and some.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• When referring to countries, 'the' is not typically used before the country's name.
